methods.label: Letters and signs
methods.explanation: A letter can represent any number, and different values give different results. Since \(a\) can be negative or 0, \(-a\) is not necessarily negative. When \(b\) is negative or 0, \(a+b\) is not greater than \(a\). Only C is correct.
